title: Meghan Markle keeps low profile on first trip after father’s arrest
summary: BRUSSELS — Meghan Markle appeared in public for the first time Tuesday since her estranged father was charged for alleged possession of child sexual abuse images — keeping a low profile…

blocks.text: BRUSSELS — Meghan Markle appeared in public for the first time Tuesday since her estranged father was charged for alleged possession of child sexual abuse images — keeping a low profile as she visited Brussels with her husband Prince Harry. The Duke and Duchess of Sussex were greeted by a cluster of photographers on arrival
